# Virtuoso Bridge — DeepSeek Harness plugin
**English** | 简体中文

A persistent DSH profile plugin for virtuoso-bridge-lite.
It turns the bridge's background SSH tunne

l and CIW-side daemon into **managed
runtimes** that survive conversations, exposes the whole Python

API to the
agent, runs batched Python inside an isolated venv, and projects runtime state
into a ri

ght-sidebar **Bridge runtime** panel while keeping configuration in a
full-page **Virtuoso Bridge**
panel in the left sidebar.

It is published on npm as
`@nekomona/dsh-virtuoso-bridge`;
source and issues live at
nekomona/dsh-vi

d on npm as
`@nekomona/dsh-virtuoso-bridge`;
source and issues live at
nekomona/dsh-virtuoso-bridge.

The plugin ships virtuoso-bridge-lite as the pinned `virtuoso-bridge-lite/`
**git submodule**, and c

an instead follow a local development repo or clone a
git repository at a chosen ref. The pin is the

exact upstream commit
`1f186abfbb3d658211743cd707f3156ed2f59a87` (2026-11-04), recorded with its ex

act
timestamp and provenance in `virtuoso-bridge-lite.pin.json`; `.gitmodules`
declares no `branch`,

so upstream `main` moving cannot change the bundled
source. The pinned source includes automatic se

ssion/instance discovery,
instance-bound daemon authentication, shared daemon setup, split host role

s, the
expanded layout/bbox/group APIs, Maestro engine configuration and the newer
Spectre presets.

Never run `git submodule update --remote`: it is the only
command that would follow a moving branch.

The published npm package carries
that same source, so an npm install needs neither git nor the sub

module; a source
checkout initialises `virtuoso-bridge-lite/` once with
`git submodule update --init

virtuoso-bridge-lite`, and the plugin reports a
clear error when it is missing.

Detailed English guide: `docs/plugin-guide.md` ·
Chinese guide: `docs/plugin-guide.zh-CN.md`
## What it provides
| Concern | Surface |
| Tool source and isolated Python environment | Host setup manager, left **Virtuoso Bridge** config

page, `virtuoso_bridge_setup` |
| Server connections and credentials | Left **Virtuoso Bridge** conf

ig page, `virtuoso_bridge_runtime`, DSH credentials service |
| Managed tunnels / daemons across con

versations | Process-wide runtime manager, Host service |
| Fixed-port or automatic-session daemon d

iscovery and selection | Config page, `instances` / `select_instance` tool actions |
| Connection st
atus, daemon/instance state, attached agents, caches, ongoing actions | Right-sidebar **Bridge runti

me** panel |
| Every public virtuoso-bridge-lite function | `virtuoso_bridge_api` (`describe` / `cal

l`) |
| Batched Python in the venv | `virtuoso_bridge_script` (jobs, status, cancel) |

The plugin is a DSH bundle package, published as the public scoped package
**`@nekomona/dsh-virtuoso

Ask the agent to install that bundle, or run the plugin manager's

No submodule and no Python checkout is required: the tarball bundles the
upstream tool source the pl

ugin needs, and the plugin creates its own venv and
pip-installs that source.

## First setup

Open the **Virtuoso Bridge** waveform icon in the left sidebar's global panel
list (beside Plugins a

nd Automation tasks); it selects the full-page
configuration panel. You can also ask the agent to ru

n
`virtuoso_bridge_setup` with action `status`. Choose a source:

## Compatibility
Verified against **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 / Cordis 4.1**:

- all four tools are registered and executable;
- runtime start, daemon health, dashboard health/sta

ntrol-channel and SSH-v3 changes do not apply to this plugin's
VBL-owned Paramiko/OpenSSH transport.

No tool activation, session-projection or prompt-assembly migration was
required; the plugin does no

t call `tools.resolve`/`tools.executable` or register
session projections. The DSH 0.2.2 release not

es mark these as breaking for
plugins that use those interfaces.
## Limitations

* A runtime can start the tunnel and deploy setup, but **cannot load SKILL into
a running Virtuoso C

IW**. The user must run the printed `load("...")` once;
the runtime then becomes `running` automatic

ally.
* No Cadence/Virtuoso or Spectre hardware is exercised by this plugin's own
tests. Live behavi

our depends on the installed virtuoso-bridge version, SSH
configuration and the CIW state.
* Python

dependencies are downloaded on first install. Reinstall/Repair after
changing the Python interpreter
ixel-level rendering depends on the host theme.
